learning: If the score holds near 271 with oval completions kept and slalom line_loss_events falls below 1, wheel_track 0.14 is confirmed. If oval completions fall and the score drops well below 271, the reduced steering gain is the cause, and kp should be raised by about 15 percent (to about 2.9) before any further geometry change.
notes: Controller identical to the verified iteration 7 and 8 controller (kd 0.35). Only wheel_track changes from iteration 9 (0.12 to 0.14), so the race isolates the turn-rate lever the Builder requested.
rationale: The Builder's entity0 tests wheel_track 0.14 (from 0.12) on the iteration 9 platform. Iteration 9 (271.06) used the same sensor layout, body and wheel radius, with kp 2.5, ki 0.05, kd 0.35, base_speed 1.5, symmetric weights and last_direction line loss. Iterations 7 and 8 reproduced 160.5 exactly, so the simulator is deterministic and single-variable tests are reliable. I keep the verified controller unchanged so that any score or line-loss change is attributable to wheel_track alone. Wider track cuts yaw per unit wheel differential by about 14 percent, so the robot may steer more gently. I expect a retune to be needed only if oval completions fall, and I will not change kp in this race to avoid confounding the test. Slalom line loss of 1.0 persists in every race, and that is the lever this test targets. The geometry is taken as supplied from entity0.
